facts.fact: The Minister of Higher Education announced the Système Intégré de Gestion des Universités (SIGU) as a centralised digital tool interconnected with other national platforms, named as ANSAE, the National Education Ministry's Porte Educ platform and SIGOU.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion des Universités (SIGU)

facts.fact: The Minister said each 2025 bachelier receives a unique identifier kept through the whole university career, and the CENOU director general said the single file with CENOU matricule numbers serves enrolment, bursaries, housing, social aid, SAMA Money allowance payment and tracking on CENOU KIBARU.
facts.system: numéro matricule CENOU / identifiant unique du néo-bachelier

systems.system: Système Intégré de Gestion des Universités (SIGU)
